svg.desc: Outcome Semantics. The main stages are novel or ambiguous case, mixed-model pool: 2+ independent models, quorum agreement?, escalate to HIL, deterministic verifier: policy-as-code and what-if, deny: no-op, audited, grounded and citations valid?, abstain to HIL, confidence over threshold?, execution-eligible to risk gate.
